title: Eigenvalues Lab
description: Interactive companion to Chapter 6 of Leon, Linear Algebra with Applications: eigenvalues and eigenvectors, linear differential equations, diagonalization, Markov chains and PageRank, Hermitian matrices, the SVD and image compression, quadratic forms, positive definite and nonnegative matrices.
lede: Find the directions a matrix only stretches, watch solutions of Y′ = AY flow along them, diagonalize and raise matrices to powers, run a Markov chain and Google's PageRank, see the SVD turn a circle into an ellipse and compress a picture, and read the shape of a quadratic form from its eigenvalues.
